exposure: Maternal betamethasone treatment (two doses of 5.7 mg)
Different durations of fetal exposure to maternal betamethasone (2 or 14 days before delivery)
outcome: Fetal lamb diaphragm function (in vitro contractile measurements)
Molecular/cellular analyses of the diaphragm (protein metabolic pathway, expression of glucocorticoid receptor and its target genes, cellular oxidative status)
cohort: Preterm lambs born to date-mated merino ewes who received either saline or betamethasone injections.
finding: Different durations of fetal exposure to maternal betamethasone had no consistent effect on the protein metabolic pathway, gene expression, cellular oxidative status, or contractile properties of the fetal lamb diaphragm, suggesting that the benefits of betamethasone are not compromised by impaired diaphragm function.
